probe.note: Five neutral probe solves (weighted sum, no floors) of the actual design problem; values are achieved, feasible designs. Ranges are indicative, not exhaustive.

justification.normalisation: Ranges span the probe-achieved values and the requirements (60 h runtime, 3 h siren, SII about 0.75 as good intelligibility, L5 0.05-0.28), with runtime worst set at 45 h (the l5 probe's 45.2 h) and the siren top just above the best probe (3.14).
justification.scalarisation: Achievement (Tchebycheff) is chosen because the probes show strongly conflicting objectives, with L5 peaking at 0.267 only when runtime and siren fall, so a weighted sum could miss the compromise points.
justification.aspiration: The aspiration sits at or slightly beyond the siren-floor probe (62 h, 3.14 h, SII 76, L5 0.073) and lifts L5 to 0.11, since the equal and voice probes reached 0.15-0.17 at lower siren endurance; the point is reachable or only marginally beyond.
justification.objective_floors: The 3 h siren endurance is a stated requirement and the siren probe reached 3.14 h, so 3.0 h is a feasible hard floor; runtime (~60 h marketing), voice and L5 are goals and are left unfloored to avoid infeasibility.
justification.weights: L5 gets the highest weight because it is the objective squeezed hardest once the siren floor binds (0.073 in the siren probe), while runtime, voice and siren share the remainder, with voice lowest because it varies only 74.6-77.7 across all probes.
